title: P02S — Build Parser-Based TOML JSON and YAML Codemods

  - tools/refactor_repo/rewrite_structured_references.py
  - tests/refactor_repo/structured_codemod/

model: sonnet

agent:
  execution_path: claude_code_direct
  reasoning: >-
    Model selection: sonnet is explicit because format-preserving structured edits,
    semantic target selection, and unsafe-case classification require non-trivial
    judgment; this is not pure lookup work suitable for haiku.

operations:
  executor:
    kind: agent_native
    implementation: runtime.logger.ExecutionLogger
  journal:
    path: plans_internal/refactor_repo/execution/P02S/execution_log.jsonl
    schema: schemas/execution_log.schema.v2.json
    format: jsonl
    write_mode: append_only
  action_protocol:
    before_action: append_act_started
    after_success: append_act_completed_closing_start
    after_failure: append_exec_closing_start
  restart:
    detection: compute_unclosed_starts

    closed_action: reuse_if_inputs_unchanged
    unclosed_action: resume_or_idempotently_repeat
  completion_gate:
    require_valid_journal: true

    require_authorized_paths_only: true

goal: >-
  After P00A activates this prompt and P01 declares the inventory-selected, version-
  pinned parser dependencies, implement parser-based TOML, JSON, and YAML transformations
  for the exact structured reference and identity changes in the resolved plan. Preserve
  comments, ordering, quoting, anchors/aliases, formatting, numeric/string types, and
  unrelated keys to the degree supported by the selected format-specific parser; when
  safe round-trip preservation is impossible, fail with an actionable diagnostic rather
  than falling back to regex. Provide before/after fixtures, write-free dry-run unified
  diffs, deterministic output, recorded tool/parser versions, idempotence, explicit
  targets/non-targets, unsafe/ambiguous warnings or failures, and residual old/unexpected
  new reference postconditions. Do not edit live TOML/JSON/YAML files; downstream owners
  apply the proven codemod only to mutation units allocated by the resolved manifest.
  Stop if P00A has no exact structured change inventory, a parser dependency is unpinned,
  or a construct cannot be transformed safely. Rollback reverts only codemod assets and
  reruns P00A ownership checks. Passing P02S unblocks activated structured-file owners.

tests:
  - description: Resolved manifest grants exact non-overlapping mutation ownership
    check: >-
      Load prompts/resolved/prompt_manifest.resolved.v1.yaml, verify it activates this
      exact prompt version, expand its path plus structured-key, symbol, transformation-
      class, move-operation, or external-target selectors, and compare those units with
      the planned and final diff/action journal plus every other active prompt's units.
    expected: >-
      Every intended and actual mutation unit is owned by this prompt exactly once; no
      unit is unowned, shared, borrowed from a successor, or merely covered by a broader
      authorized path.

  - description: Format-specific fixture matrix covers required syntax and semantics
    check: >-
      Enumerate TOML, JSON, and YAML fixtures and verify cases for nested keys, arrays,
      tables/mappings, aliases/anchors, comments where legal, quote styles, multiline
      values, scalar types, old/new references, ambiguous/dynamic values, malformed input,
      and already-migrated input.
    expected: >-
      Every resolved transformation class has a named exact output or named diagnostic;
      unrelated structure and values remain semantically and, where promised, textually stable.

  - description: Parsers and transformation versions are pinned and recorded
    check: >-
      Compare P01 dependency pins, runtime imported versions, codemod metadata, and
      checkpoint evidence for every TOML/JSON/YAML parser and transformation contract.
    expected: >-
      Exact parser/tool versions and transformation version are consistent and no
      environment-only unpinned dependency is used.

  - description: Dry-run is deterministic, reviewable, and write-free
    check: >-
      Snapshot fixture/live rehearsal bytes, run dry-run twice with stable ordering,
      compare unified diffs/diagnostics byte-for-byte, and compare all inputs afterward.
    expected: >-
      Dry-run output is deterministic, identifies format/key/change owner, and writes nothing.

  - description: Apply output is exact and a second application is empty
    check: >-
      Apply each transformation to disposable copies, parse and compare with expected
      semantic/text fixtures, then apply again and capture diff/status.
    expected: >-
      First output matches exactly and the second application produces no change for
      TOML, JSON, and YAML.

  - description: Unsafe inputs and residual references fail closed
    check: >-
      Exercise malformed files, duplicate/ambiguous keys, unsupported tags, alias cycles,
      type-changing substitutions, unexpected old references, and unexpected newly
      introduced target references.
    expected: >-
      Each unsafe case warns or fails according to explicit policy, and residual/new-
      reference postconditions prevent silent partial success.

  - description: Inventory-selected live rehearsal changes no repository file
    check: >-
      Run dry-run against every structured file/change unit assigned by P00A, reconcile
      candidates with the inventory/resolved manifest, and compare git/filesystem state.
    expected: >-
      Candidate sets match exactly, discrepancies block downstream activation, and no
      live repository byte changes.

  - description: Independent Codex QA accepts the P02S checkpoint
    check: >-
      Gate a versioned P02S checkpoint report with qa-gate-codex-run using shared criteria
      and this prompt, P00A structured-change inventory, parser pins, fixtures, dry-run,
      determinism, idempotence, unsafe/residual results, and specification v8 as grounding;
      threshold blocker, at most five iterations, then verify.
    expected: The witnessed verify result is QA_PASSED and identifies the passing artifact.
    verifier:
      execution_path: codex_plugin
      invokes:
        type: skill
        skill: qa-gate-codex-run
      reasoning: Structured transformation safety cannot be self-certified by its author.

loop:
  steps:
    - Apply restart handling and verify P00A activation/ownership plus P01 parser pins.
    - Freeze structured targets/non-targets and fixture metadata before implementation.
    - Implement parser-based dry-run, apply, diagnostics, and residual postconditions.
    - Run exact-output, determinism, idempotence, unsafe-input, and live dry-run tests.
    - Record rollback verification and complete independent QA.
    - Apply completion gates and identify only resolved structured-file owners as successors.
  stopping_condition: >-
    Stop successfully only when all eight tests pass for TOML, JSON, and YAML, live
    rehearsal is write-free, parser versions are pinned, scope/journal gates pass, and
    QA verify says QA_PASSED.
  resume_check: >-
    Compare resolved change-unit, parser, fixture, and codemod digests before reusing any
    closed action; rerun all affected formats after a change.
  escalation: >-
    Stop on an unpinned parser, unsupported round-trip construct, ownership mismatch,
    or repeated failure; never substitute regex for a structured edit.
  retry_policy:
    auto_retry: [tool-error, partial-run]
    requires_fix: [missing-input, bad-input, wrong-output, other]
